notes.title: Expeditions Update - Out Now!
notes.content:
Gather your monkeys and prepare for more adventure with the Expeditions Update, out now! 🐒

🗺️ Quests
💎 Trinkets
✔️ Save upgrade system
📖 Bestiary
& more!

New features:
40+ New Trinkets – 

 It is now possible to level your player character via trinkets. There are 4 trinkets slots that can be earned that can be slotted with a variety of trinkets that can radically change gameplay. 
 Trinkets such as burning damage, death bombs, infection, shields, tool damage and damage reduction and more! 
 Trinkets have 4 unique tier slots so you can customise to your playstyle. 
 Trinkets recipes are earned by performing objectives for the Taskmasters. 
 A new trinket bench can be built to support this. 


4 New TaskMasters – 

 There are 4 new taskmasters on islands beyond the starting one. 
 These offer themed tasks which when completed offer ever increasing rewards most tied into the trinket system. 
 More than 50 new challenges each with a unique reward. 
 Taskmaster types are… Beastmaster, Collector, Gourmand, Salesman. 


5 New Pets – 

 You can find an egg and if nurtured, gain a companion to keep you company. 


Caves changes – 

 These have had an overhaul, they are now ‘gated’, you will need something to get into them. 
 There are now many new resources inside that are required to support trinkets. 


Bestiary – 

 There is now a bestiary in the journal that tracks animals and collectibles and also displays resources you might find on them. 


Labyrinths – 

 Now offer new rewards at the end. Have also been tweaked with regards to internal mobs. 


Legendary Weapons – 

 Can now be repaired on the repair bench and gained as rewards from taskmasters. 


New Animals – 

 2 new animals, one of which is a ‘loot goblin’. 


Landregen Refactor – 

 Generation has been changed so that there are now more distinct islands, increasing in difficulty along with breadcrumbs to lead you in the right direction should you with. 


Regenerate - 

 Start a new game with the new features and take your inventory, mysterious chest, unlocked blueprints and 5 monkey friends along with you for a headstart. This is required for the new features. 


Elites – 

 Elite variations of existing animals, needed for some of the tasks. 


Player initiated raids – 

 With the right item you can now summon elite variants to fight, earning rewards to hand in to the Taskmasters. 


Expandable Inventory – 

 Fulfilling objectives for the Taskmasters will reward you with items that can increase your inventory size. 


New Items – 

 There are many new items to me found to support the new features.
 

Mob Variants – 

 New harder Orclings can be now found, especially on Skull Island. 


New collectibles – 

 Over 10 new collectibles to find and new items to craft to find them. 


New items & resources – 

 New items, recipes and resources have been added to support new features.
 

New Currency – 

 Mysterious tokens can sometimes be offered as a reward from the task masters. 


New Token Shop – 

 Unlock via tasks the right to purchase powerful trinket recipes from the new Token Shop. 


Bug fixes and improvements:

 Fixed an issue with crops where some had missing or incorrect shadows. 
 Fixed an issue where some animation frames were missing on north facing attacks. 
 Fixed an issue where the player silhouette was not appearing behind mountains. 
 Fixed an issue where players were able to add multiple weapons to the repair bench causing those items to disappear. 
 Fixed an issue where some items were not visible when placed on a wall. 
 Fixed an issue where on a rare occasion Monkeys would disappear when returning from an online session. 
 Fixed an issue where reward chests were sometimes indestructible. 
 Fixed an issue with the Steam controller profile where the A button was incorrectly being set as the B button. 
 More save corruption fixes. 
 General bug fixes and improvements. 


Enjoy!

notes.title: Experimental Branch Update! - Faster Rafts, Death Location Marked on Map & More!
notes.content:
Survivalists 🐒 

A new update has landed on your island with some very exciting updates

Expeditions Experimental Changes:
Player

 Player death locations now have a gravestone on the map. 


NPCs

 The Beastmaster now sells the lures needed to summon the elite animals. 
 Every taskmaster now has their own shop! They will sell useful items related to their general theme. 
 Taskmasters have been polished and their task-chains have been re-ordered and refined. 
 Legendary weapons are now made available after completing the final task for each taskmaster. 
 Token shop rewards are now delivered in clusters, giving you more choice when you visit the mysterious stranger and requiring you to travel back less frequently. 

World

 Vaults now contain puzzles. Your world will need to be regenerated for this to take effect. 
 Gold Ingot drop rate has been decreased, as it was too easy to acquire. 
 Tier 1 Crystal stalagmites can now be destroyed with a flimsy pickaxe. 


Items and Recipes

 Pelts now consistently drop from wolves, big cats and boars. These are a new important resource, which fetch a solid price from 
 Backpack recipes have been rebalanced to require more pelts. 
 Pelts are now used to make spears, swords & clubs. 
 Pelts are also used in the crafting of sails, which will make them slightly easier to craft. 
 All items are bought and sold individually now, rather than in pre-defined stack sizes. 
 Elixir and clean water now require a glass bottle of dirty water, instead of separate water / glass bottle items. 
 Makeshift bowls no longer have durability and now stack instead. Existing makeshift bowls are no longer used in any crafting recipes. 
 New Item: Gold Sword Handle. This is a component used in the crafting of gold swords and have a steep resource cost. 
 Balancing pass has been done on all trinkets. Each one should have a distinct use and feel powerful. 
 Cooking pot tree has been moved to the campfire. The cooking pot now displays the recipes added in the farming update. 
 Pastry is significantly easier to make as it no longer requires water


Weapons and Tools

 Metal & gold requirements for weapons have been significantly increased. 
 Swords will now return the sword handle item when they break. Gold swords will return the new gold sword handle item. 
 Swords now have significantly more durability. 
 Durability of all tools and weapons have been increased. 
 Sharpened versions of tools & weapons now have more durability than their base versions. 


Structures

 Teleporters are now significantly easier to make, they now only need glowing rock instead of gems. 
 Campfires, cooking pots & forges only need to be lit once. The cost of lighting them has been increased. The campfire now needs 3 timber, opposed to 1. While the forge will require 10 charcoal to light it. 
 Charcoal can now be made on a campfire.
 Structures now return their full cost when destroyed, allowing for easy rebuilding. 
 Both rafts are now slightly faster. 
 The raft no longer slows down when damaged. 
 

Enemies and Animals

 Orcling caches now drop from the big boss orcs, these contain a key item for crafting the top-tier trinkets. 
 Live fish can now be dropped onto the ground. 
 Elite stag can no longer be stunlocked. 
 Elite enemies now have a new health bar and correctly apply debuffs! 
 Attack patterns of boars, stags, wolves & turtles have been improved. 


Get exploring!

notes.title: The Survivalists Farming Update Is Live!
notes.content:
Hey Survivalists!

[previewyoutube=cs24jf7OVjQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The Farming Update has now washed ashore the Steam live version! This update ties together the Animal and Dangerous Plants updates that brought new enemies, bosses, taming. Adding Farming content with new crafting benches, crop system, dyeing customisation, combat update, fishing and many more top community requests!

Thank you to everyone for there feedback that has helped us continue to improve the game and the support so many have shown. We hope this update shows how committed we are to making the game the best it can be. 

These 3 updates will be coming to all other platforms soon, we’ll let everyone know when we have time frames! 

Farming Update Notes

Crop System


 Players can now plant and grow their own crops including new varieties of plants to grow. Remember to water them!
 Domesticated crops can offer a higher yield of resources including rare items.
 Dangerous plants can now be grown to act as base defences.
 New cooking recipes have been added utilising new crops.
 New structures and items have been added to support new farming system.
 Monkeys can now plant seeds and water plants if taught.
 Seeds can be found on certain animals throughout the world.


Dyeing Bench


 A bench that allows players to colour walls, floors and chests to suit their tastes. 


We wanted to give those players who love base building more customisation and control over how their island homes looked!

New Structures


 Tools and weapons can now be repaired with the new repair bench.
 Weapons and tools can now be improved by using the grindstone structure.
 Alchemy bench allows the player to transmute certain items into others.
 Food processor bench allows food resources to be converted.
 Cosmetic structures have been added including pond that can be populated with fish.
 Refuse pit can be used to destroy items. (We know some people will be happy to de-clutter!)
 Decorative water features have been added.


Fast Raft 


 A new faster raft can be crafted using crop resources. 


There was a lot of community requests for the raft to be speedier and we thought it would be a good idea to have a better version of the raft that can do just that! We hope everyone has fun speeding from island to island!


Fishing


Cast away! Nets and fish traps can be crafted enable catching fish live or for food. 


Raid Improvements


 Raids are now focused on the player and only occur during a bloodmoon. 
 Players now receive plenty of warning prior to a raid to enable them to pick the right course of action. 


We had a lot of community requests both that raiding on a base could happen when you were away and you felt a little helpless. This way, there is plenty of warning for the raids and you can make decisions on whether to try to get as far away from your base with no items and take the fall or prepare your defences to fight of the enemies.

Taming


 Tamed animals can be used as guard animals. 


Larger Inventory


 Access to a larger inventory via a backpack has been added. 


This was a big community request, there is now a permanent extra row of slots you can access to drop things in and out of your hot bar. You can however still teach a monkey to pick up a chest too for extra storage.

Group Pickup


 Alternate methods of pickup have been added, no need to spam the button.
 

This might be the biggest community request, people were tired of having to pick up individual items, now if you hold down pickup you will suck in all items on the ground granted you have enough space in your backpack!



Multitool


 No longer needs to be selected, if it is in the inventory it will be used to craft. 



New Rare Resources


 Rare resources are now present in the world needed for some recipes.



Combat & Stamina


 An overhaul to combat giving more fluid combat.
 Greater control over direction of attacks.
 Lunge and knockback changes.
 Stamina has been altered reducing running out when in combat and harvesting resources.
 Flatter difficulty curve for enemy health.



Other adjustments


 Damage values added to weapon tooltips.
 Durability values added to tooltips.
 Some reworking of weapon and tool values to make clearer the benefits of using the right tool for the right job.
 Better colour coding on items to make clearer their rarity.
 Baby animals are now present in the world.
 New rare crops have been added to the world (*requires new save for them to appear naturally although all the resources are obtainable through getting the seeds from monsters/animals to grow these plants yourself!)
 Monkeys now ‘bark’ needs as well as an icon.
 Loot pools have been rebalanced.
 Summon favourite monkeys from anywhere with the new summoning banana.
 Durability on weapons and tools increased.
 Slight increase to player and monkey movement speed.
 A host of new recipes have been added to complement and support new features.
 Online privileges are now turned on by default.



Bug Fixes


 Fixed an issue where Shadows were displaying incorrectly around Teleporters.
 Fixed instances where sleeping could cause a desync between the visual and actual time of day.
 Fur rugs are no longer able to be placed ocean tiles using the raft.
 Fixed an issue preventing players from using the Host’s shared monkeys unless both players have the privilege turned on.
 Fixed an issue which caused raft music to continually play.
 Fixed an issue where players could place storage chests on swamp tar pits.
 Fixed an issue where the growing up particle effect for baby animals was desynced.
 Fixed an issue that prevented players from changing the colour of their character or monkey using Mouse and Keyboard.
 Fixed an issue where pins placed in Vaults and Labyrinths were incorrectly displayed outside of these areas.
 Fixed an issue which caused the Structural Integrity achievement to unlock when building the Taming Bench.
 Fixed an issue preventing interaction with some lootable objects.
 Fixed an issue where on rare occasions a player’s monkeys could not travel back with them when leaving an online session.
 Fixed an issue where on rare occasions after a raid, damaged chests could no longer be used by monkeys.


Experimental Branch Bug Fixes

Thanks for everyone that played the test at the start of this week and helped us track down an issue where monkeys wouldn’t listen to Survivalists, with your data we were able to implement a quick fix!

Thank you again everyone for your feedback and support, we hope that you enjoy everything that has been added in this patch and we will see you for the next developer update!

notes.title: Message in a Bottle - Quality of Life and The New Update
notes.content:
Survivalists!

Following 'Island Orientation' pre launch, we now have 'Message in a Bottle'! This is our developer diary where we'll show behind the scenes developer workings and teasers of upcoming content! 

A big content update is coming soon that will act as an almost part two to the animal update, though today we aren't spoiling that just yet. ːsteamsadː

We will be instead focusing on the extra parts to this update and the quality of life additions lots of players have been asking for! Thank you everyone for your invaluable feedback so far.

Corrupted Save File Fix Is Here! 

Before we start, we'd like to again apologies to those that experienced the save file issues with infinite loading and corrupted saves. Our update to fix this has been on the live version for the past couple of weeks. 

Backpack

It has been one of the hottest requested community features and whilst you can employ a monkey friend to carry a storage box. We've listened and a backpack to extend your personal storage is coming!

The first official update has just splash landed onto the live islands. Thank you all for giving us such amazing feedback, we have taken a lot of your input and worked hard to get these improvements out to you as fast as we could.

Accessibility Changes


 Added accessibility option to disable dynamic camera zoom. If disabled, camera will stay at max zoomed out level. (This is designed to help those who suffer from motion sickness)
 Key binding update – exposed more unique options for “Interact” so these can be bound to different keys.

Difficulty Changes


 Balancing tweaks to make combat more challenging
 Orcling flee range reduced by 20% 
 Health increased for Orclings and Spectres 
 Increased number of animals that spawn from warrens 
 Increased number of Orclings that spawn at camps 
 Health increased for large nocturnal animals (panthers and devil boar) 
 Monkeys no longer do knockback

 Rebalancing for the cost of items from the Mysterious Strangers shop. 
 Tweaks made to food recipes
 Combat quests have been added  
 Lore quests appear more often in the mysterious stranger’s shop
 Treasure chests no longer respawn after the blood moon  
 Rebalanced building recipe costs
 Most cartables and structures have had increase of +1 for main ingredient needed.
 Some recipes now require additional ingredients
 Loot pools for structures updated to reflect recipe changes

 Change to make it easier to select a single monkey with the mouse when in monkey management mode

 Single monkey can now be more easily selected when using a controller 
 Monkey work icons no longer overlap monkey names 



General Changes


 Projectiles no longer auto target non-hostile things in the world (except for cogs) 
 Player’s max stamina slightly increased 

Bug Fixes


 Fix for not being able to complete some in-progress recipes when upgrading from an earlier build 
 Fix for corrupted saves caused by bugged mysterious chest 
 Mysterious chest should no longer disappear

 Fixed not being able to use a teleporter whilst holding a chest

 Fix for Journal not opening if mini-map icon is clicked with the mouse 
 Fix for an error that was triggering if 100 quest bottles were collected 
 Fix for an error that would sometimes trigger when buying a quest from the mysterious stranger 
 Fix for monkeys not learning to put items if chest is the item is dragged and dropped into the chest with the mouse

 Both meat kebab recipes now produce the same item

 Fix for blueprints not being able to be built on rare occasions
 Fix for monkeys not filling their inventory to max capacity 
 Fix for gears and torches sometimes being invisible in labyrinths and vaults

 Missing localization for a handful of newly added or edited strings. There will be a hotfix to add these in as soon as possible.
 Some players may experience an issue where attempting to assign the space bar to some options sometimes reopens the rebinding menu and prevents the key from being assigned. This is currently being investigated.

Welcome Survivalists!

This is the second island orientation and you'd better put on your captains hat as we're getting nautical! 

We're also thrilled to announce that we're opening a new Discord server for everyone to discuss the game, give us your feedback and more ahead of launch! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36338036/0ed267a26f723188e36a9ce400151dd43c44c3ca.png
JOIN HERE

More Islands?

In The Survivalists, each world is a set of randomly generated islands, each can contain unique biomes which give specific resources you'll need to not just survive but thrive! 

Some small connecting islands in shallow water can be reached by just walking across. Though deep water and ocean can be deadly and to get to islands across the big blue, you'll need something to ferry you safely across!

http://i.imgur.com/4baKjcnh.gif

Raft

To build a raft, you'll first need to gather the required resources for both the raft and the sail! You'll also need to build up your camp and learn new crafting trees to put together the components for the raft!

Once all of your resources are collected and your components forged, it's time to place a blue print for the bottom of the raft. Then add the resources to the blue print and whack it with your multitool! Finally, you need to place on top the sail and you are ready to hit the high seas!

https://i.imgur.com/reEjR2f.gif

notes.title: The Survivalists Beta Survival Tips
notes.content:
Hey survivalists!

Today we have some tips to help you survive in the beta! If you want anything else to be shown, be sure to let us know in the replies below!

Bed Making

Sleep is important!

To create the bed you will need to first open your blue print menu, 'RT' on controller or 'R' on keyboard and select the 'Flimsy Bed' and place it where you want it. First you must add some comfy padding to the bed which you can craft from the personal crafting tree, access with 'D-Pad down' on controller or 'C' on keyboard. Add this to your placed blue print and select your multi tool and craft the base for the bed. After this is completed, you must add a makeshift bed sheet which can also be crafted from the same spot as the padding. Once crafted, select in your inventory and add to the top of the beds base. Voila!

https://i.imgur.com/gXj3K52.gif

Saving

Beds are important, that's why making them is tip #1! To save the game you must return to a bed. Activating a bed will give you 3 options. To sleep, save and save + sleep. Sleeping will advance time, so depending on the time of day you might want to save but keep the game in the morning state. The other thing the bed does after sleeping in it, is saving your respawn location which defaults to your initial starting area near your shipwreck. So if you want to make sure you return to your new base, use a bed! 

https://i.imgur.com/uJPfquX.gif

 Training Monkeys 

To train a monkey you first need to enter the monkey menu, which is 'LT' on a controller or 'Q' on a keyboard. They can mimic anything you can do. Some things require a tool to complete like crafting, where the monkey will need a multitool, which you can throw to them by selecting in your inventory and pressing 'X' on controller or 'R' on keyboard. To train a monkey you must press 'Y' on a controller or 'E' on keyboard then hover over the monkey you want to train. You can also hold the button down to expand the selection field to train multiple monkeys at once. A banana countdown symbol will appear above the monkeys head, this indicates they are in learning mode. You must then perform the action you want them to copy before the timer runs down, for example here we pick up meat off the floor and put it in the chest to train the monkey to collect and store resources.

https://i.imgur.com/F2w0b7f.gif

 Monkey Combat Training 

To train a monkey in combat you must do the above, but hit a hostile enemy with a weapon and it will train the monkeys in combat. To increase their combat power, be sure to give them a suitable weapon! In the full version of the game, you will be able to craft training dummies for the monkeys to learn on rather than enemies.

https://i.imgur.com/0Z37bco.gif

Mobile Storage

A lot of survivalists have been asking about extra storage that they can take with them. Well, here it is! You can pick up a chest with 'A' on controller or 'Spacebar' on keyboard and use the same input to hand it to a monkey to carry. Make sure the monkey is following you in the monkey menu and then you have mobile storage. To take the chest back you just need to use the same inputs to grab from them, then it is 'B' on controller or 'F' on keyboard to drop the chest on the ground.

https://i.imgur.com/jpG60BL.gif

We hope these quick tips have helped and that everyone is having fun with the beta!

notes.title: Island Orientation #1 - Beds, Rebirth and Saving.
notes.content:
Welcome Survivalists!

This is your first island orientation, listen closely as this is one of the most important!

Beds!

One of the first things you'll need to set-up to thrive is the humble bed. It's also one of the first things on your crafting tree. On the topic of trees, you will need some palm leaves and grass to craft the most basic 'flimsy bed'. Don't forget to also craft your sheets to go on top, the islands nights are very chilly!

https://i.imgur.com/6rHra1g.gif

Saving

To save your game in The Survivalists you'll need to first craft one of these beds. Then like any good bed, it likes to be slept in. Once you drift off to sleep for the first time this will then save the game for you. Fancy that!

https://i.imgur.com/uHffmMy.gif

Rebirth

You'll want to sleep in a bed before you croak in the wilderness - maybe after becoming a tiger's chew toy! Why? Well - when coming around you'll return to the last place you slept and if not you start back where you first shipwrecked on the island. You could have a very long walk, swim or maybe crawl to where you've dropped all your items. 

https://i.imgur.com/YL0amLE.gif

Better Beds! 

Upgrading your bed won't just give you a better nights sleep! But those extra winks will make you become stronger, just look at the benefits of a lightweight bed vs a flimsy bed. 
https://i.imgur.com/WqB2XiX.gif

Islanders, we hope you've taken in all of these pointers and remember sleep is very important to become a great survivalist.

https://i.imgur.com/avlUzB5.gif
Sleep to succeed!
